launched_product_one_liner: A 90-day science-backed climbing program that uses 113 evidence-based protocols to help intermediate climbers break through plateaus and send V6.
launched_product_core_problem: Climbers hit performance plateaus and cannot progress to advanced bouldering grades (V6+) despite continued effort, lacking structured, evidence-based training methodology.
launched_product_target_audience: Intermediate to advanced recreational climbers who are stuck below V6 and seeking structured, scientific training to break through their bouldering plateau.
launched_product_value_proposition: Guaranteed V6 bouldering breakthrough within 90 days through a structured program of 113 evidence-based protocols designed by an elite-level climber and physiotherapist.
launched_product_differentiation_claim: Created by Israel's first 5.14c climber who holds an M.Sc in Physiotherapy — combining elite climbing achievement with clinical sports science expertise, delivered through 113 evidence-based protocols.
launched_product_proof_points: Coach Ofer Blutrich is Israel's first 5.14c climber
Featured in Rock and Ice magazine
launched_product_availability: Available online via climbingpill.ai (WooCommerce-based sales on oferblutrich.com suggests online purchase/enrollment)

framing_rules: Frame as a science-backed, evidence-based system — not generic coaching
Position the coach's dual expertise (elite climber + physiotherapist) as the foundation of the method
Frame the 90-day timeline as a structured program with a clear endpoint, not open-ended training
Treat the 113 protocols as a proprietary system, not a collection of tips
to_emphasize: The intersection of elite climbing experience and clinical physiotherapy expertise
Specific, measurable goal (V6) with a defined timeframe (90 days)
Injury prevention as an integrated part of performance training
